description: Ville de Paris publishes annual full-day and night-time road noise indicators for several permanent Paris monitoring stations. The source distinguishes station settings such as the ring road, urban boulevards, squares and quieter streets, and discusses acoustic road surfacing associated with a LIFE project. It describes Lden as a weighted full-day indicator and Ln as a night-time indicator. The title and description refer to measured noise, while the same description states that the data were determined using CNOSSOS and explains its infrastructure sound-propagation algorithms. Both statements are retained; the metadata does not settle the division between measurement and model processing for each value. The supported role is assessment of noise exposure from road infrastructure. CSV and JSON exports are listed under ODbL. The metadata gives annual updates, a start date of 31 December 2008 and no stated end date. Station-level values and model-to-measurement agreement have not been inspected. No directly related catalogued record has been established.
